name: smooth_local_environment_revision
hypothesis: After failure of thresholded heteropolar topology, smooth periodic bond summaries plus nearest-shell dispersion and constituent-normalized within-site mixing entropy may generalize better than hard chemical partitions.
scope: Development proxy structures only; fixed 3.2/3.5 A edges, covalent radii, and locally normalized species occupancies. Mixed constituents remain one geometric site; entropy describes occupancy mixing, not configurational thermodynamics.
falsification: Falsified as a revision if weighted validation MAE does not beat E01's 8.62790 K. The mixing refinement is not supported if the aggregate revision also fails to improve E01.
